palavogikos-collab-mydata-root.description: Issue Greek invoices through AADE's timologio, get the MARK, keep one JSON per invoice, push it into the ERP (SAP Business One today; other adapters welcome) and email the PDF. Trigger on: τιμολόγιο, τιμολόγησε, έκδοση τιμολογίου, invoice, myDATA, timologio, MARK, ΤΠΥ, πελάτης ΑΦΜ, προεπισκόπηση τιμολογίου.
